en: A black‑and‑white, likely early‑20th‑century postcard showing a quiet tree‑lined street with single‑story wooden houses on the left and right. In the distance stands a church-like building with a tower and pointed roof, possibly with a clock or bell opening. The scene is rural or small‑town, with unpaved or lightly paved road and sparse pedestrians. A German caption is printed in a white band below the image.
